title: Freshness asks for the next milestone
goal: Report an empty backlog and roadmap as an owner decision
acceptance: A committed test: empty backlog and roadmap give one 🤔 finding; an open record or milestone gives none
The rule says the agent derives records only from an agreed milestone
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-15 from similar freshness findings (B-026, F-080-T01). Not a measurement.
